depth_to_organized_points — 3D range_image op

• 資料種類:depth → pointmap

• 呼叫:import range_image; range_image.depth_to_organized_points(depth, fx=None, fy=None, cx=None, cy=None)(或 ops3d.get("depth_to_organized_points"))

用法

organized 深度圖 → 網格對齊的 3D 點 (H,W,3)。
